channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: DEG DEG: Axmed Madoobe oo dhaliil culus u jeediyay Xasan Sheekh – “Xamar la iskuma aaminayo, talana la iskuma tagayo!”
item.description: Madaxweynaha Dowlad Goboleedka Jubbaland, Axmed Maxamed Islaam (Axmed Madoobe), ayaa dhaliil kulul u jeediyay Madaxweynaha Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, isaga oo si cad u muujiyay sida uu uga soo horjeedo habka uu u wajahayo arrimaha siyaasadeed ee dalka.

item.title: Espanyol oo waayay Àlex Calatrava: ciyaaryahanka khadka dhexe oo ka dillaacay seedda jilibka
item.description: Kooxda Espanyol ayaa xaqiijisay in ciyaaryahankeeda khadka dhexe Àlex Calatrava, oo loo yaqaan 'Cala', uu ka dillaacay seedda hore ee jilibka bidix (ACL) intii lagu jiray tababar, isla markaana qalliin lagu sameyn doono Talaadada soo socota.

item.title: Taliye-ku-xigeenka Booliska Soomaaliya, Sareeye Guuto Cabdalla Cabdalla, oo is casilay kuna biiray mucaaradka
item.description: Sareeye Guuto Cabdalla Cabdalla Maxamed, oo ahaa Taliye-ku-xigeenka Ciidanka Booliska Soomaaliyeed iyo Taliyaha Hawlgallada Gaarka ah, ayaa 19 November ku dhawaaqay inuu iska casilay xilalkiisa, isagoo hay'adaha amniga ku eedeeyay caddaalad-darro iyo eex.

item.title: Peres Jepchirchir, horyaalka adduunka ee marathonka, oo saddex sano laga mamnuucay orodka doping dartiis
item.description: Hay'adda Daacadnimada Orodka (AIU) ayaa 19 November saddex sano ka mamnuucday orodyahanadda Kenya Peres Jepchirchir, oo haysata horyaalka adduunka ee marathonka, kaddib markii baaritaan lagu helay daawada EPO, waxaana laga qaaday guushii marathonka Sydney.

item.title: Dhismaha sanduuqa maalgashiga Sacuudiga ee Riyadh oo waxyeello gaartay kaddib weerarro cusub oo Xuutiyiinta
item.description: Dhismo dheer oo ku yaalla caasimadda Sacuudiga ee Riyadh, oo ay xarun u tahay Sanduuqa Maalgashiga Dadweynaha (PIF), ayaa 19 November waxyeello gaartay, kaddib markii isbahaysiga uu Sacuudigu hoggaamiyo sheegay inuu ka hortagay gantaallo ay Xuutiyiintu ku ganeen Riyadh iyo koonfurta dalka.

item.title: NBA: Bulls oo 137-107 ku jabisay Nets, tababare Jordi Fernández oo sheegay inay ahayd ceeb
item.description: Chicago Bulls ayaa 137-107 kaga adkaatay Brooklyn Nets kulan NBA ah oo dhacay 18 November, taasoo Nets u ahayd guuldarradii 11aad ee xilli ciyaareedkan.

item.title: Axmed Madoobe oo xarigga ka jaray dhismayaal cusub oo AD Ports ka hirgelisay dekedda Kismaayo
item.description: Madaxweynaha Jubaland Axmed Maxamed Islaam (Madoobe) ayaa habeenkii 18 November xarigga ka jaray dhismayaal cusub oo shirkadda Imaaraadka ee AD Ports Group ka hirgelisay dekedda Kismaayo, maalin kaddib markii Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh dhaleeceeyay heshiisyada dekedaha.

item.title: Minnesota: Hooyo Soomaali ah oo loo xiray dilka labadeeda carruur ah oo 3 iyo 5 jir ah
item.description: Booliska magaalada Savage ee gobolka Minnesota, Mareykanka, ayaa xiray hooyo Soomaali ah oo 33 jir ah, kaddib markii labadeeda carruur ah oo 3 iyo 5 jir ah ay ku dhinteen toogasho Arbacadii ka dhacday guri ku yaalla magaalada.

item.title: Flamengo oo 2-1 ka soo noqotay Athletico Paranaense, hoggaanka Brasileirão-na 6 dhibcood ku kordhisay
item.description: Flamengo ayaa garoonka Maracanã ugu soo noqotay guul 2-1 ah oo ay ka gaartay Athletico Paranaense, iyadoo Palmeiras oo labaad ah ay 2-1 guriga Cruzeiro looga adkaaday, sidaasna Flamengo ay hoggaanka horyaalka Brazil ugu kordhisay lix dhibcood.

item.title: Trump oo Shenzhen kula kulmay Putin kadibna Xi Jinping, kuna adkaystay in Iran aan caawimaad looga baahnayn
item.description: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa Khamiistii magaalada Shenzhen ee Shiinaha wadahadal kula yeeshay Madaxweyne Vladimir Putin, kadibna la kulmay Madaxweyne Xi Jinping, iyadoo uu sheegay in Mareykanku uusan u baahnayn caawimaad Ruushka iyo Shiinaha si uu u soo afjaro dagaalka Iran.

item.title: NBA: Utah Jazz oo 109-97 ku garaacday Lakers, sagaal guul oo isku xigta oo Lakers lahayd-na joojisay
item.description: Utah Jazz ayaa Arbacadii Los Angeles 109-97 kaga adkaatay Lakers, kooxda ugu fiican NBA, iyadoo Keyonte George uu dhaliyay 30 dhibcood, sidaasna ay joojisay sagaal guul oo isku xigta oo Lakers ay gaartay.

item.title: NBA: Cooper Flagg oo 33 dhibcood dhaliyay, Mavericks-na 116-94 ku garaacday Warriors
item.description: Cooper Flagg ayaa dhaliyay 33 dhibcood iyo 9 caawin, Dallas Mavericks-na Arbacadii 116-94 kaga adkaatay Golden State Warriors oo aan haysan Stephen Curry, sidaasna ay ku joojisay saddex guul-darro oo isku xigta.

item.title: Koonfur Suudaan oo maalgashadayaasha caalamka u bandhigtay 14 qaybood oo sahan saliid ah
item.description: Koonfur Suudaan ayaa maalgashadayaasha caalamiga ah u bandhigaysa 14 qaybood oo loogu talagalay sahanka saliidda, iyadoo diyaar u ah inay 24 iyo 25 November Juba ku martigeliso shirka toddobaad ee South Sudan Oil and Power.

item.title: F1: Ollie Bearman oo ka xun in Haas aysan weli xaqiijin heshiiskiisa 2027
item.description: Darawalka Haas Ollie Bearman ayaa sheegay inay niyad-jab ku tahay in kooxdu aysan weli ku dhawaaqin inuu sii joogi doono 2027, isagoo ah darawalka keliya ee aan weli loo magacaabin xilli ciyaareedka soo socda, iyadoo xilli ciyaareedku dhammaad ku dhow yahay.

item.title: Valérien Ismaël oo loo soo bandhigay tababaraha cusub ee Le Havre, kooxda ugu dambeysa Ligue 1
item.description: Le Havre oo ku jirta kaalinta ugu dambeysa Ligue 1 ayaa Arbacadii warbaahinta u soo bandhigtay tababaraheeda cusub Valérien Ismaël, oo 51 jir ah, kaasoo ballan qaaday inuu kooxda ka badbaadin doono hoos u dhaca.

item.title: Diego Pavia oo noqday ciyaaryahanka ugu horreeya ee laga doorto UFL, Columbus Aviators ayaa qaatay
item.description: Diego Pavia, oo hore ugu ciyaari jiray Vanderbilt kana mid ahaa musharrixiinta kama dambaysta ah ee abaalmarinta Heisman Trophy, ayaa Arbacadii noqday doorashada koowaad ee xulashada ciyaartoyda horyaalka United Football League (UFL), waxaana qaatay Columbus Aviators.

item.title: Uganda oo booliska ku amartay inay joojiyaan bandhigyada iyo isu-imaatinka degmooyinka xuduudda, Ebola dartiis
item.description: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka Uganda ayaa booliska ku amartay inay joojiyaan riwaayadaha, xafladaha, shirarka siyaasadeed iyo isu-imaatinka kale ee degmooyinka xuduudda ee khatarta sare ku jira, iyadoo Ebola ay sii faafayso Jamhuuriyadda Dimuqraadiga Congo.

item.title: Elon Musk oo sheegay in lacagtii uu ku bixiyay doorashooyinka Mareykanka ay ahayd 'nacasnimo'
item.description: Elon Musk ayaa Arbacadii sheegay inuu dareemayo 'nacasnimo' lacagta rikoorka ah ee uu ku bixiyay doorashooyinka xilliga dhexe ee Mareykanka, kadib guuldarrooyin ballaaran oo soo gaaray xisbiga Jamhuuriga.

item.title: Ashley Sanchez oo ku guuleysatay abaalmarinta MVP ee NWSL kadib xilli 20 gool ah
item.description: Weeraryahanka North Carolina Courage, Ashley Sanchez, ayaa loo doortay ciyaartoyga ugu qiimaha badan (MVP) xilli ciyaareedka horyaalka haweenka Mareykanka ee NWSL, kadib markii ay dhalisay 20 gool.

item.title: IAEA: Kuuriyada Waqooyi oo dhamaystirtay ballaarin cusub oo lagu sameeyay xarunta uranium-ka ee Yongbyon
item.description: Agaasimaha Guud ee Hay'adda Tamarta Atomiga Caalamka (IAEA), Rafael Grossi, ayaa sheegay in Kuuriyada Waqooyi ay dhammaadkii October dhamaystirtay dhismaha dibadda ee ballaarin cusub oo lagu sameeyay xarunta sifeynta uranium-ka ee Yongbyon.

item.title: Sawir uu sameeyay Van Gogh oo rikoor ah 190.4 milyan oo doollar lagu iibiyay
item.description: Shirkadda xaraashka ee Sotheby's ayaa New York ku iibisay sawirka 'Châtaigniers en fleurs' ee Vincent van Gogh 190.4 milyan oo doollar, taasoo ah qiimaha ugu sarreeya ee abid xaraash lagu iibiyo shaqo uu sameeyay.

item.title: Kenya: Yaraanta caanaha oo sii xumaatay iyadoo abaartu saameysay beeralayda xoolaha
item.description: Caanaha ayaa ku yaraaday qaybo ka mid ah Kenya, gaar ahaan dukaamada Nairobi, kadib markii xilli qalalan oo dheer uu hoos u dhigay wax-soosaarka beeralayda xoolaha caanaha, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Vanessa Bryant iyo Pau Gasol oo la sheegay inay isu diyaarinayaan iibsashada kooxda Los Angeles Sparks ee WNBA
item.description: Vanessa Bryant, carmalladii xiddigii Lakers Kobe Bryant, iyo Pau Gasol ayaa la sheegay inay wadajir u diyaarinayaan dalab ay ku iibsanayaan kooxda Los Angeles Sparks ee horyaalka kubadda koleyga haweenka (WNBA), sida ay werisay Sports Business Journal.

item.title: Cam Skattebo oo joojiyay dabaaldegga 'backflip' kadib dhaawacii Aidan Hutchinson
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka New York Giants, Cam Skattebo, ayaa sheegay inuu muddo joojinayo dabaaldegga uu dhabarka isaga rogo, kadib markii xiddigga Detroit Lions Aidan Hutchinson uu dhaawac jilibka ah ku soo gaaray isagoo dabaaldegaya.

item.title: Ciyaaryahanka Ravens Marlon Humphrey oo raali-gelin ka bixiyay hadal uu ka sheegay magaalada Baltimore
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka khadka daafaca ee Baltimore Ravens Marlon Humphrey ayaa Arbacadii raali-gelin bixiyay, kaddib markii uu barnaamijkiisa podcast-ka ku sheegay in Baltimore ay ugu fiican tahay soo saarista dambiilayaal, sida ay wariyeen CBS Sports iyo The Athletic.

item.title: Mareykanka oo cunaqabateyn cusub saaray urur uu ku tilmaamay waji u ah Xisbullah
item.description: Wasaaradda Maaliyadda Mareykanka ayaa Arbacadii cunaqabateyn saartay ururka Wa Ta'awanu Association ee Lubnaan, oo ay ku tilmaantay waji ay Xisbullah u adeegsato ururinta lacagaha, iyo saddex qof oo Lubnaan ku nool, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Muddadii is-diiwaangelinta doorashada madaxtooyada FIFA oo xirantay, Infantino oo ah musharaxa ugu horreeya
item.description: Muddadii musharaxiinta doorashada guddoomiyaha FIFA ayaa xirantay, iyadoo Gianni Infantino uu yahay musharaxa loo badinayo inuu ku guuleysto shirweynaha 18 March ee Rabat, halka Philippe Diallo iyo Kozo Tashima ay iyana tartamayaan, sida ay wariyeen AS iyo RMC Sport.

item.title: Luke Littler oo laga reebay Grand Slam of Darts kaddib guuldaro 10-8 ah oo uu ka soo gaaray Jermaine Wattimena
item.description: Horyaalkii difaacanayay Luke Littler ayaa si lama filaan ah looga saaray Grand Slam of Darts ee Wolverhampton, kaddib markii ciyaaryahanka reer Holland Jermaine Wattimena uu 10-8 kaga adkaaday wareegga labaad, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.

item.title: Manchester United oo tixgelinaysa tallaabo sharci ah kaddib bixitaanka JJ Gabriel ee Real Madrid
item.description: Manchester United ayaa la sheegay inay diyaar u tahay inay tallaabo sharci ah qaaddo haddii ay hesho caddeyn muujinaysa in kooxo kale ay la xiriireen ciyaaryahanka 16 jirka ah ee JJ Gabriel intii uu heshiiska kula jiray, sida ay wariyeen warbaahinta Ingiriiska iyo Spain.

item.title: Juventus Haweenka oo 2-0 ku garaacday OH Leuven, una gudubtay wareegga ka-saarista Champions League
item.description: Kooxda haweenka Juventus ayaa Arbacadii magaalada Biella 2-0 kaga adkaatay OH Leuven ee Belgium ciyaartii 5aad ee wareegga horyaalka UEFA Women's Champions League, waxayna xaqiijisay inay u gudubto wareegga ka-saarista iyadoo ay ka harsan tahay hal ciyaar.
